text:
Maya Patel: Thinking about a compact per-route KPI mini-card for Console that surfaces p50/p95/p99 token latency, throughput (req/s), error rate, and a small kernel attribution sparkline.
Derek Chen: +1. can we also show cache hit rate (KV) and avg tokens/req? those affect kernel choice skew.
Anika Roy: Agree — UX should make it easy to correlate p99 spikes with kernel fallsbacks/batching changes.
Pranav Iyer: Wanted: a lightweight PromQL/Clickhouse snippet we can use for the card backend. Something that returns p50/p95/p99 per-minute and total reqs.
Maya Patel: rough proto PromQL:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(route_token_latency_bucket{route="/chat"}[5m])) by (le))
sum(rate(route_requests_total{route="/chat"}[1m]))
```
Anika Roy: we should bucket by kernel and kv_hit boolean: label_join maybe `kernel` label and `kv_hit` dimension so frontend can stack.
Derek Chen: sampling: we can't compute token-level p99 for every route at 10s cardinality. proposal: reservoir sample 1% of requests + deterministic sample for top 100 routes.
Pranav Iyer: ops-bot just posted an alert yesterday when p99 jumped 2x because kernel fallback to fp32 happened during an autoscale. If we show kernel attribution on the card, heatmap should point to those windows.
ops-bot: [deploy] 2025-11-12T18:04:21Z rollout: kernel-optimizer v2 -> fallback policy engaged on pool-3
Maya Patel: UX idea: mini-card shows three small panels: left numeric (p50/p95/p99, req/s, err%), middle 1h sparkline for p95 with kernel color bands, right small table of top 3 reasons (kv_miss, kernel_fallback, batching_underfill).
Anika Roy: For retention, keep full token latency histograms for 7 days, aggregates to 30d. Sampling controls in Console advanced settings.
Derek Chen: Implementation ask for eng-sre/telemetry: add `route_token_latency_bucket` label set to include `route`, `kernel`, `kv_hit`, `quantization`.
Pranav Iyer: I'll open an infra PR to add the labels + sampling config. cc @Maya for card mockups.
Maya Patel: thanks — I'll drop a Figma link and a simple query list in this thread later. :thumbsup:
Anika Roy: thumbs. Also add a small checkbox to the card to toggle 'show kernel bands' (default on for dedicated customers).
Derek Chen: one more: expose per-route unit-cost estimate (tokens * cost_per_token) as optional metric for product conversations.
Maya Patel: noted. will add to feature spec. end of thread.
